best_idea: Compute each approach's arrival time on the server from (distance minus target radius) over speed, then resolve the strike at a fixed fraction of the attack time with a re-check before damage.
decision_why: Keep the arrival-time rule and the strike-time re-check, but drop the per-NPC 100 ms setInterval loops because Frankendom's server tick needs one fixed step and a per-tick NPC budget.
acceptance: A server test runs one fixed-step duel where the defender steps out of reach after the swing starts; the hit must not land at the hit tick if the range check fails there, and the arrival tick for a 3-unit approach matches the ETA formula.
